news.text: The winter #calciomercato window in Italy will open early: kick-off is set for December 28 (instead of January 2) with the closing set at 8 PM on February 1st.[Nico Schira]

🇮🇹🧤 #Vicario is increasingly convincing and his performances have changed the initial plans of #Juventus. The club would be inclined to buy him on a permanent basis at the end of the season for €8M, a figure considered highly favorable. The pre-agreement for a contract until 2030 would further strengthen the idea of a long-term stay. Meanwhile, they continue to monitor young goalkeepers like #Palmisani.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

💪 "Zeki #Çelik is the best signing of the summer window in terms of money spent. It highlights that he has been performing solidly as a left-back despite his natural position being on the right (where he played in #Gasperini's #Roma, who used him more as a center-back or on the right), that he score goals (1 against #NEC) and assists, and that he is an untouchable player at the moment.Even so, #Juventus needs a backup for that position due to fixture workload (Europa League, Coppa Italia, etc.).There is skepticism on the psychological and performance recovery of #Cambiaso on the left, months ago he was close to an official offer from #Guardiola's #ManchesterCity.It would be crazy to remove #

🔛✍️ "Talks have begun for the contract renewal of Nico #González. He seemed destined to leave, he had been on the mercato for a long time: #Roma, #Inter, #AtleticoMadrid and Saudi clubs had all inquired about him. In the end, #Juventus decided to keep him and today he is an added value. The bianconero club also wants to hold tight onto #Conceição: negotiations have kicked off for him as well for a renewal until 2031."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔜 The arrival of #Neto to #Juventus is expected tomorrow.[Mirko Di Natale]

✅ Looking ahead to January, the situation regarding Rayan #AïtNouri needs to be monitored as he is not finding much playing time at #ManCity.👀 For #Juventus, who were tracking him at the end of the mercato, if the situation remains like this, he could become a serious opportunity.[Mirko Di Natale]
Neto is expected to be in Turin tomorrow 🧤⚪️⚫️[Romeo Agresti]
Expected Norberto #Neto’s medicals tomorrow. Then he will sign the contract (until June 2027) and will have the first training for #Juventus on Monday #transfers[Nico Schira]
🚨 Excl. - #Juventus have opened talks with #DouglasLuiz’s agents to discuss a possible contract extension. #transfers[Nico Schira]

"NICO, CLASS AND GRIT WORTHY OF #JUVE"Interview with #Causio: "#González breaks matches wide open, he has that something extra"The ex bianconero ace: "At the end of training, I used to stay behind with #Bettega and #Anastasi to practice crosses, #Conceição and #Kolo should do the same. With #Carnevali and #Massara we are in good hands". #DouglasLuiz, renewal to spread out his salary.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🧐⚡️ "#Cambiaso is almost ready to gradually return to action at the end of the international break. He has been carrying his ankle problem for some time, a reason why his recovery phase has been managed with great caution. At the same time, #Juventus is starting to think about the backup. For the January mercato, the club is already monitoring some profiles."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹⁉️ "#Juventus wants to understand what kind of availability #Ekhator will be able to offer when he returns, in order to then evaluate him on the pitch and make a decision in January. Today, the prevailing idea is that he could be far more useful staying with the team rather than being sent out to play elsewhere. There is, therefore, the possibility that he will stay and officially begin his adventure as a bianconero. This past summer, he had already received several requests, including one from #Porto, but the club declined."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇹🇷🆙 "#Yildiz's recovery is progressing gradually, with maximum caution, but also with positive signs. The November international break is a possible window to evaluate his return to the pitch, which will nonetheless have to be managed carefully through a process of athletic and physical rehabilitation. The objective is to bring him back to his best in the new year, taking advantage of the next few months to allow him to regain full fitness."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🙃 BACKGROUND STORY: NO TO #PORTO FOR THE LOAN OF #EKHATOR The player is working to overcome his muscular issues and is targeting a recovery by late October or the first days of November at the latest. Upon his return, #Ekhator will be the only traditional number 9 available to the coach, with a good chance of finding consistent playing time.The possibility of a loan move in January cannot be ruled out, but no final decision has been made by anyone so far. This past summer, the club repeatedly knocked back inquiries from #Porto, who would have gladly taken him on loan. [Giovanni Albanese - La Gazzetta dello Sport via @AverageJuventinoGuy]

😱 LEFT FLANK: THE NAMES IN THE NOTEBOOK🔥 #Massara has two dossiers on his desk: David #Raum from #Leipzig and Tyrick #Mitchell from #CrystalPalace have been proposed and are intriguing. They have three things in common: obviously the role indicated above, their status as free agents and their agency, ROOF. Both are planning to move as free agents at the end of the current season, but it is not forbidden for #Juve to make a move as early as January.[Tuttosport via @AverageJuventinoGuy]
